rows.title: The germinal products set's own review: germinal answers in their species blocks, its unfinished-species messages, its shorter addresses card and its return to the germinal list
rows.detail: A trader reviewing a germinal products notification needs to read back what the germinal pages asked for. The storage temperature reads back once, in a 'Commodity details' card at the head of the goods section. Each species block reads back its own total gross weight in kilograms, which may be a decimal, its quantity in units or pieces, its number of packages and its germinal identification details. The germinal set has its own copy of the review, so the live animals review keeps the rows it shows today. The germinal set never asks for additional details, a county parish holding number or a permanent address, so its review shows no row for them and asks nothing of them before submit. Where a selected species is short of what submit needs, the review names that species and links to its block, whether one species or several are selected. Once the notification is submitted, its confirmation page takes the trader back to the germinal products list rather than the live animals one.
acceptanceCriteria: In the germinal products set's review, '2. Description of the goods' opens with a card titled 'Commodity details' that has no Change link in its header (prototype:dr2-1-source prototype-dr2-1-source-p11-202, prototype-dr2-1-source-p11-203; ruling:sam-2026-11-27 ruling-sam-2026-11-27-p1-004)

The germinal products set's 'Commodity details' card shows a 'Temperature' row with the temperature chosen, on every germinal notification (prototype:dr2-1-source prototype-dr2-1-source-p11-205; ruling:sam-2026-10-09 ruling-sam-2026-10-09-p1-021)

On an editable germinal products review, the 'Temperature' row carries its own Change link, which opens the commodity details page with the temperature pre-filled (prototype:dr2-1-source prototype-dr2-1-source-p11-198, prototype-dr2-1-source-p11-205)

In the germinal products set's review, each species block shows 'Total gross weight' with that species' weight followed by ' kg', so a weight entered as 12.5 reads back as '12.5 kg', 'Quantity (unit/pieces)' with that species' quantity and 'Number of packages' with that species' number of packages (prototype:dr2-1-specs prototype-dr2-1-specs-p6-084, prototype-dr2-1-specs-p6-085, prototype-dr2-1-specs-p6-086; trace:prototype-dr2-1 trace-prototype-dr2-1-p11-036, trace-prototype-dr2-1-p11-037; ruling:sam-2026-11-27 ruling-sam-2026-11-27-p1-004; ruling:sam-2026-10-09 ruling-sam-2026-10-09-p1-022; c-234)

In the germinal products set's review, a germinal species block shows 'Identification details' as a list of each identifier field's own label and the value saved against it (prototype:dr2-1-source prototype-dr2-1-source-p11-087; ruling:sam-2026-10-09 ruling-sam-2026-10-09-p1-042)

The live animals set's review species block shows 'Number of animals' and, where packaging applies, 'Number of packages (when required)', with no 'Commodity details' card at the head of '2. Description of the goods' (repo:frontend repo-frontend-p6-049, repo-frontend-p6-050; ruling:sam-2026-10-09 ruling-sam-2026-10-09-p1-014, ruling-sam-2026-10-09-p1-110)

The germinal products set's review 'Consignment addresses' card shows one row each for Place of origin, Consignor, Consignee, Importer and Place of destination, and those five rows only (repo:frontend repo-frontend-p6-068; prototype:dr2-1-source prototype-dr2-1-source-p11-110, prototype-dr2-1-source-p11-111; ruling:sam-2026-10-09 ruling-sam-2026-10-09-p1-017, ruling-sam-2026-10-09-p1-018)

A germinal products notification with origin, commodity selection, consignment details, import reason, arrival, transport and consignment addresses complete, and at least one identifier saved for every selected species, has nothing marked unfinished on its review and Continue goes on to the declaration (repo:frontend repo-frontend-p6-115; ruling:sam-2026-10-09 ruling-sam-2026-10-09-p1-016, ruling-sam-2026-10-09-p1-017, ruling-sam-2026-10-09-p1-018)

In the germinal products set's review, a selected species with no quantity is named in the error summary with 'Enter the quantity for <species>', the species name in lower case, and that entry links to the species' own block (prototype:dr2-1-source prototype-dr2-1-source-p11-058, prototype-dr2-1-source-p11-059, prototype-dr2-1-source-p11-197; ruling:sam-2026-10-09 ruling-sam-2026-10-09-p1-057, ruling-sam-2026-10-09-p1-110; c-234)

In the germinal products set's review, a selected species with a quantity but no entry holding an identifier is named in the error summary with 'Enter at least 1 animal identifier for <species>', the species name in lower case, linking to the species' own block, when it is the only species selected and when several are (prototype:dr2-1-source prototype-dr2-1-source-p11-058, prototype-dr2-1-source-p11-059; ruling:sam-2026-10-09 ruling-sam-2026-10-09-p1-057; c-234)

After a germinal products notification is submitted, the link on its confirmation page back to the trader's notifications opens the germinal products set's list of notifications (ruling:sam-2026-10-09-pm ruling-sam-2026-10-09-pm-p2-056; ruling:sam-2026-10-09 ruling-sam-2026-10-09-p1-006, ruling-sam-2026-10-09-p1-009)
rows.notes: Re-distil 27 November, review-and-submit drafter: this is existing row inc-105, redrafted for this area's three requirements only. Pass 2 combines three slices that are one page in one feature folder (the germinal copy of check-answers): the germinal read-back (req-842), the germinal copy's readiness test, shorter addresses card and confirmation return (req-1843), and its unfinished-species messages (req-1841); apart they would repeat the same germinal notification set-up, review render and ladder. c-492 keeps the temperature in a 'Commodity details' card and total gross weight per species; the overruled consignment-level gross weight is named nowhere here. c-234 makes quantity each species' required count; c-277 and c-134 settle that every selected species, a lone one included, is named in its own right. The live animals criterion is a no-change guard and asks for no edit to the live animals check-answers folder, which the overview-and-review branch owns. The combiner should keep inc-105's other requirements (req-2755, req-2756, from the declaration-and-submitted area, on the germinal confirmation page), their criteria, and its dependsOn and externalDependsOn as they stand.
